description: Draw a local image file on the panel at the panel's own resolution (from its model; pass size when it has none). resize: fit (whole image, padded black), fill (cover, cropped), exact (stretched), none (must already be the panel's size, else an error). Colours are reduced to the panel's 256-colour palette only when the image has more.

file.description: Local filesystem path to the image.

lease.description: The token from lease_acquire, while you hold the panel's lease.

mac.description: Optional MAC address of the target display (default: active display).

name: show_image

description: Describe a panel: link state, model, width/height in pixels (how it was decided: model_source), the chassis (which product it is and how big it is), the features the vendor app enables for that model (speaker, sd_card, temp_sensor, wifi, radio, vj, clock_style), and the screens the app offers that model (null for an unrecognised model).

lease.description: The token from lease_acquire, while you hold the panel's lease.

mac.description: Optional MAC address of the target display (default: active display).

description: Read the device's current volume, brightness, channel, orientation, mirror. A field the daemon could not read is null, and `errors` names it with the daemon's reason and code -- a null is never the only thing you know.

lease.description: The token from lease_acquire, while you hold the panel's lease.

mac.description: Optional MAC address of the target display (default: active display).

description: Show a short message on the panel for duration_ms, then give the panel back -- its live widget returns by itself; nothing waits. Refused while someone holds the panel's lease. Returns the notification's lease: lease_release dismisses it early.

lease.description: The token from lease_acquire, while you hold the panel's lease.

mac.description: Optional MAC address of the target display (default: active display).

name: notify

description: Borrow the panel's screen for ttl_ms (renew before it runs out). Pass the returned lease to every drawing call; anyone else is refused, and the panel's live widget pauses. When the lease ends -- released, or expired because you stopped renewing -- the widget's newest frame comes back at once.

holder.description: Who is asking, shown to anyone refused.

mac.description: Optional MAC address of the target display (default: active display).

name: lease_acquire

description: Extend your lease to ttl_ms from now.

mac.description: Optional MAC address of the target display (default: active display).

name: lease_renew

description: Give the screen back now; says what the panel went back to (job: its live widget, none: nothing to restore).

mac.description: Optional MAC address of the target display (default: active display).

name: lease_release
